ideas.pitch: A platform connecting students across different colleges and academic specializations to form balanced multidisciplinary hackathon teams based on complementary skill sets.
ideas.title: PeerSync: Inter-College Project Collaboration Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a pain familiar to every student participant at a multidisciplinary innovation event, making it immediately relatable to the judges.

ideas.pitch: An open innovation tracking dashboard for student hardware and software prototypes, managing version history and component dependencies during tight hackathon schedules.
ideas.title: CampusLoop: Open Innovation Asset Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates a live, fully functional utility designed specifically to help student-led project building events run smoothly.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision garbage sorting assistant that classifies recyclable objects using lightweight machine learning models and webcam input for open innovation science tracks.
ideas.title: EcoSort AI: Smart Recycling Bin Classifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs a real, working, demonstrable live demo with a camera feed that immediately captures judges' attention.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-driven sensor dashboard tracking campus water parameters and predicting local supply anomalies before they occur using lightweight regression.
ideas.title: AquaSense Campus: Water Quality Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages predictive data analytics in a clean web dashboard, following the exact formula of successful IoT and environmental hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: A localized acoustic and browser-based mesh network protocol enabling ultra-fast peer-to-peer messaging without relying on an active internet connection.
ideas.title: MeshTalk: Offline Campus Walkie-Talkie Bridge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an unusual low-level communication build that stands out in a room full of standard web applications.
